body.voice_description: Create an original chess-coach voice for an illustrated character. Character: Curious collaborator from Chennai who explores alternatives with the player. Voice direction: Warm male baritone with a Tamil-inflected Indian English accent. Open, curious questions that leave a small thinking pause, then a friendly, clear idea. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: What if we check the defender first? Once it moves, that piece is unprotected and can be taken. Compare that with keeping it where it was.

encoding.method: SoundFile float64 decode; arithmetic channel mean; band-limited FFT resample to 48000 Hz; libsndfile Ogg Opus at compression level 0.93
